subject: SIG encryption appendix — operator custody timeline & rotation artifacts
messages:
From: Amanda Lee <security@evergreenbank.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: request for operator custody timeline, shift logs, and rotation artifacts

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for taking SIG with us last week. The Evergreen audit team has a few follow-ups specifically around encryption operational controls before we finalize our SIG submission:

- A short timeline showing HSM operator custody (who had access/by-shift) for March 2026 — March 2027.
- Representative shift logs (redacted) showing operator sign-on/sign-off and ceremony notes.
- The KMS key rotation schedule used for tenant keys (dates + responsible role).
- Firmware attestation and version for the HSMs in our tenant region (any change history between 2026-03 and now).

Can you provide these artifacts or point us to a secure folder? We only need sampled artifacts and a short narrative (1 page) describing your operator custody controls and emergency rotation process.

We have a compliance review on Friday 23 Apr and would ideally like these by EOD Wed 21 Apr. If anything is sensitive, a redacted sample is fine — please just note what was redacted.

Appreciate it,
Amanda Lee
Senior InfoSec, Evergreen Bank
security@evergreenbank.com

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Amanda Lee <security@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: request for operator custody timeline, shift logs, and rotation artifacts

Amanda — thanks for the note and the deadline heads-up.

We can deliver a compact package that includes:
- a 1-page narrative describing HSM operator custody and split-ceremony flow,
- a sampled shift log CSV (redacted for PII),
- our KMS rotation schedule spreadsheet for 2026–2027, and
- the HSM firmware attestation PDF with version history.

One clarification: do you need operator-level usernames (redacted) included in the shift logs, or is role-level mapping sufficient (e.g., ‘HSM Operator’, ‘Crypto Lead’)?

I’m looping in Ben (product security) and Marissa (crypto ops) to assemble the artifacts. We’ll upload to a shared Drive link and share the DocuSign/chain-of-custody references as needed.

We’ll aim to have the files to you by EOD Wed 21 Apr.

—Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: FW: SIG: request for operator custody timeline, shift logs, and rotation artifacts

Ben / Marissa / Priyom — please assemble the artifacts Amanda requested (Evergreen Bank). Scope and notes below:

Required items (sampled / redacted where appropriate):
1) Operator custody timeline (Mar 2026 — Mar 2027) — one-page narrative + table of role assignments by month.
2) Shift logs — provide a sampled CSV (3 contiguous weeks) from our operator rotation; redact email addresses and any customer-identifying tenant ids. File name: hsm_shiftlog_sample.csv
3) KMS rotation schedule — spreadsheet listing key IDs (redacted), rotation dates, and the role that initiated rotation. File name: kms-rotation-schedule-2026-2027.xlsx
4) HSM firmware attestation — PDF with firmware versions and any applied patches during the period. File name: hsm-firmware-attestation-202703.pdf

Security notes for redaction: remove PII (full operator email usernames), replace tenant IDs with stable placeholders (e.g., TENANT-1234). Add a short metadata.txt describing redactions.

Ben — can you provide the one-page narrative? Marissa — can you export the shift log and attestations and confirm the firmware version history? Priyom — can you double-check anonymization and upload to the Drive folder and set link to "restricted share" and provide link to Amanda?

Need a draft by EOD Tue so Kimberly can review and send final by Wed EOD.

Thanks —
Kimberly

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Amanda Lee <security@evergreenbank.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: request for operator custody timeline, shift logs, and rotation artifacts

Amanda — sending the package we assembled for Evergreen’s SIG appendix. The Drive link and a short summary are below. All artifacts are sampled/redacted as noted in metadata.txt. If you need anything in a different format, let me know.

Drive folder (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cEVERGREEN-SIG-APPENDIX
DocuSign chain ref (operator attestations): https://www.docusign.com/evergreen-sign/ABC123

Quick summary of attachments included:
- hsm_shiftlog_sample.csv — 3-week contiguous sample (Mar 08–Mar 28 2026). Columns: date, shift_start, shift_end, role, action_summary. Operator usernames replaced with ROLE_* tokens.
- kms-rotation-schedule-2026-2027.xlsx — rotation calendar showing automated rotation windows and manual emergency re-keys. Key IDs replaced with KEY-* placeholders.
- hsm-firmware-attestation-202703.pdf — firmware build numbers, attestation statements, and the patch bulletin for 2026-03 -> 2027-03.
- metadata.txt — explains all redactions and provides contact point for any audit follow-ups.

Short narrative (attached in Drive as "hsm_operator_custody_narrative.pdf"):
- Operator custody: split-ceremony with two-operator signoff; operators are assigned via monthly rotation; emergency entry requires on-call manager authorization + recorded DocuSign attestation.
- Rotation process: KMS automates scheduled rotations; manual rotations follow documented playbook with rollback steps and are logged in ticketing system.
- Audit controls: periodic replay of shift logs to detect anomalies; firmware changes require signed attestation and are cross-checked against vendor bulletin.

If Evergreen’s audit team wants additional samples (longer log window or unredacted operator mapping under NDA), we can coordinate that through your legal team.

Thanks — and let me know if you want to hop on a 20-minute call for walk-through.

—
Kimberly Park
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

Attachments: hsm_shiftlog_sample.csv (sample), kms-rotation-schedule-2026-2027.xlsx (spreadsheet), hsm-firmware-attestation-202703.pdf (PDF)
